therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Time to Progression-Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR) Assessment

results.target_engagement_evidence: Serum mapatumumab concentrations achieved therapeutic levels (mean 555,157.6 ng/mL at end of infusion, sustained levels >100,000 ng/mL throughout treatment)
biomarker_changes: Anti-mapatumumab antibodies developed in 13/49 patients (6 transient positive, 7 persistent positive)
results.dose_information: Mapatumumab 30 mg/kg IV infusion plus sorafenib 400 mg orally twice daily
